title: The Pink Vanity Reset
description: A pink vanity reset: a pink LED mirror, a 2-tier rotating organizer, a striped velvet jewelry box, a 16-piece brush set with a rhinestone holder, a cloud trinket dish and a pink bubble ceramic bathroom set.
intro: A vanity should make mornings feel like the good part of the day. A mirror that glows, a place for every perfume, brushes that live in something pretty and a little dish for your rings. Six finds, one pink reset.

approval.source: Jodie sent the final images in chat and asked for the rest of the system to be finished and scheduled
approval.scope: Publish this Lifestyle article and its supplied images

sections.heading: The mirror and the organizer
paragraphs: A pink LED mirror with soft, adjustable light does the heavy lifting, and a pink two-tier rotating organizer with gold poles keeps perfume and skincare within one spin of your hand.

sections.heading: Brushes, jewelry and a cloud dish
paragraphs: A 16-piece brush set lives in a pink quilted holder with rhinestones. A pink striped velvet jewelry box with a heart mirror keeps the necklaces untangled, and a pink cloud trinket dish catches rings and earrings.

sections.heading: The bubble bathroom set
paragraphs: The pink bubble ceramic set has a soap dispenser, toothbrush holder, tumbler and soap dish. It is not on the Amazon list because Amazon's list tool would not accept it, so its link is in the shopping links on this page.

sections.heading: What is real and what is styling
paragraphs: The six finds are the LED mirror, the rotating organizer, the jewelry box, the brush set, the cloud dish and the bubble bathroom set. The flowers, candle, perfume bottles, magazine, scrunchie, claw clip, stool, throw and everything else in the photos are styling extras.
Photos are AI-generated styling ideas, so check each listing for the exact item, colour and size before you buy.
